title: "`r {source('_setup.R'); tr('github.title')}`"

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
## GitHub: repository state, issue and pull-request activity,
## traffic with its per-repository start-of-series notice, and releases.
##
## Commits must never be a headline: they are the LAST section here, one
## series among several, with `github.commits.lead` stating why they sit
## there. They appear on no other page and in no headline position.
##
## The truncated-traffic caveat is met by `github.traffic.started`, printed once per
## repository from `gh_traffic.json -> series[].series_start_date`.
source("_setup.R")

issues_json <- zb_json("gh_issues")
activity_json <- zb_json("gh_activity")
traffic_json <- zb_json("gh_traffic")
releases_json <- zb_json("gh_releases")

repos <- zb_df(issues_json$repos)
activity <- zb_points(activity_json$series, "repo")
traffic_series <- zb_df(traffic_json$series)
traffic <- zb_points(traffic_json$series, "repo")
traffic_monthly <- zb_df(traffic_json$monthly)
releases <- zb_df(releases_json$releases)

activity_date <- zb_get(activity_json, "latest_data_date")
traffic_date <- zb_get(traffic_json, "latest_data_date")

#' Reshape a wide daily table into the long form the charts expect, with the
#' metric column already carrying its localised label.
zb_long <- function(df, metrics) {
  metrics <- intersect(metrics, names(df))
  if (!length(metrics) || nrow(df) == 0L) {
    return(data.frame())
  }
  parts <- lapply(metrics, function(m) {
    data.frame(
      date = df$date, repo = df$repo,
      metric = factor(tr(paste0("github.metric.", m)), levels = zb_metric_labels(metrics)),
      value = as.numeric(df[[m]]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, parts)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: header
#| results: asis
zb_out(zb_page_header("github.html", zb_get(issues_json, "snapshot_date")))
```

`r tr("github.lead")`

```{r}
#| label: privacy
#| results: asis
zb_out(zb_note(tr("github.privacy_note")))
```

## `r tr("github.repos.title")`

```{r}
#| label: repos
#| results: asis
if (nrow(repos) == 0L) {
  zb_out(zb_no_data(tr("github.repos.none")))
} else {
  repos <- repos[order(repos$repo), , drop = FALSE]
  table <- data.frame(
    repo = paste0(
      '<a href="https://github.com/', zb_esc_attr(repos$repo), '">',
      zb_esc(repos$repo), "</a>"
    ),
    open_issues = zb_int(repos$open_issues),
    open_prs = zb_int(repos$open_prs),
    oldest = ifelse(
      is.na(repos$oldest_open_issue_days),
      tr("common.none"),
      tr_f("github.days", n = zb_int(repos$oldest_open_issue_days))
    ),
    stars = zb_int(repos$stars),
    forks = zb_int(repos$forks),
    watchers = zb_int(repos$watchers),
    last_push = zb_datetime(repos$last_push_at),
    archived = zb_bool(repos$archived),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  zb_out(zb_table(
    table,
    labels = c(
      tr("common.repository"), tr("github.col.open_issues"),
      tr("github.col.open_prs"), tr("github.col.oldest_issue"),
      tr("github.col.stars"), tr("github.col.forks"),
      tr("github.col.watchers"), tr("github.col.last_push"),
      tr("github.col.archived")
    ),
    caption = tr_f("common.snapshot_date",
      date = zb_date(zb_get(issues_json, "snapshot_date"))
    ),
    align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "l", "l"),
    raw = "repo"
  ))
}
```

## `r tr("github.issue_age.title")`

`r tr("github.issue_age.lead")`

```{r}
#| label: issue-age
#| results: asis
aged <- repos[!is.na(repos$oldest_open_issue_days) & repos$oldest_open_issue_days > 0L, , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(aged) == 0L) {
  zb_out(zb_no_data(tr("github.issue_age.none")))
} else {
  aged$repo <- factor(aged$repo, levels = aged$repo[order(aged$oldest_open_issue_days)])
  plot <- ggplot(aged, aes(x = oldest_open_issue_days, y = repo)) +
    geom_col(fill = zb_palette[[2L]], width = 0.6) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = zb_int(oldest_open_issue_days)),
      hjust = -0.15, size = 3.4, colour = "#1f2328"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max(aged$oldest_open_issue_days) * 1.15)) +
    labs(x = tr("github.issue_age.axis_x"), y = NULL) +
    zb_theme()

  zb_out(zb_fig(
    plot,
    alt = tr_f("github.issue_age.alt", date = zb_date(zb_get(issues_json, "snapshot_date"))),
    caption = zb_chart_dateline(zb_get(issues_json, "snapshot_date")),
    height = zb_facet_height(nrow(aged), per = 0.45, base = 1.6)
  ))
}
```

## `r tr("github.activity.title")`

`r tr("github.activity.lead")`

```{r}
#| label: activity
#| results: asis
issue_pr_metrics <- c(
  "issues_opened", "issues_closed",
  "prs_opened", "prs_merged", "prs_closed"
)
long <- zb_long(activity, issue_pr_metrics)
if (nrow(long) == 0L || sum(long$value, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
  zb_out(zb_no_data(tr("github.activity.none")))
} else {
  plot <- ggplot(long, aes(x = date, y = value, colour = metric, linetype = metric)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.55) +
    facet_wrap(~repo, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = zb_palette) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "longdash", "dotted", "dotdash", "twodash")) +
    zb_scale_x_day() +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
    labs(x = tr("common.date"), y = tr("github.activity.axis_y")) +
    zb_theme()

  zb_out(zb_fig(
    plot,
    alt = tr_f("github.activity.alt", date = zb_date(activity_date)),
    caption = zb_chart_dateline(activity_date),
    height = zb_facet_height(length(unique(long$repo)), per = 1.5, base = 1.6)
  ))
}
```

## `r tr("github.traffic.title")`

`r tr("github.traffic.lead")`

```{r}
#| label: traffic-start
#| results: asis
# The start of the traffic series, stated per repository. Everything
# before it is unrecoverable by design of the GitHub API.
if (nrow(traffic_series) == 0L) {
  zb_out(zb_no_data(tr("github.traffic.none")))
} else {
  notices <- vapply(
    seq_len(nrow(traffic_series)),
    function(i) {
      paste0("<li>", zb_esc(tr_f(
        "github.traffic.started",
        repo = traffic_series$repo[[i]],
        date = zb_date(traffic_series$series_start_date[[i]])
      )), "</li>")
    },
    character(1)
  )
  zb_out(
    '<p class="zb-note"><span class="zb-note-mark" aria-hidden="true">ⓘ</span> ',
    zb_esc(tr("github.traffic.started_title")), "</p>",
    '<ul class="zb-inline-list">', paste0(notices, collapse = ""), "</ul>"
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: traffic-chart
#| results: asis
traffic_metrics <- c("views", "view_uniques", "clones", "clone_uniques")
long <- zb_long(traffic, traffic_metrics)
if (nrow(long) > 0L) {
  plot <- ggplot(long, aes(x = date, y = value, colour = metric, linetype = metric)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.55) +
    facet_wrap(~repo, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = zb_palette) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "longdash", "dotted", "dotdash")) +
    zb_scale_x_day() +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
    labs(x = tr("common.date"), y = tr("github.traffic.axis_y")) +
    zb_theme()

  zb_out(zb_fig(
    plot,
    alt = tr_f("github.traffic.alt", date = zb_date(traffic_date)),
    caption = zb_chart_dateline(traffic_date),
    height = zb_facet_height(length(unique(long$repo)), per = 1.5, base = 1.6)
  ))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: traffic-monthly
#| results: asis
if (nrow(traffic_monthly) > 0L) {
  ordered <- traffic_monthly[order(traffic_monthly$month, traffic_monthly$repo), , drop = FALSE]
  table <- data.frame(
    month = zb_month(ordered$month),
    repo = ordered$repo,
    views = zb_int(ordered$views),
    view_uniques = zb_int(ordered$view_uniques),
    clones = zb_int(ordered$clones),
    clone_uniques = zb_int(ordered$clone_uniques),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  zb_out(zb_table(
    table,
    labels = c(
      tr("common.month"), tr("common.repository"),
      tr("github.metric.views"), tr("github.metric.view_uniques"),
      tr("github.metric.clones"), tr("github.metric.clone_uniques")
    ),
    caption = tr("github.traffic.monthly_title"),
    align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r")
  ))
  zb_out(zb_note(tr("github.traffic.uniques_note")))
}
```

#| label: releases

if (nrow(releases) == 0L) {
  zb_out(zb_no_data(tr("github.releases.none")))
} else {
  table <- data.frame(
    repo = releases$repo,
    tag = releases$tag,

      tr("github.col.prerelease")
    ),
    label = tr("github.releases.title"),
    align = c("l", "l", "l", "l", "l")
  ))
}

## `r tr("github.commits.title")`

`r tr("github.commits.lead")`

```{r}
#| label: commits
#| results: asis
# Commits appear here and nowhere else, as one secondary series at the
# foot of one page. No total, no ranking, no target.
long <- zb_long(activity, "commits")
if (nrow(long) == 0L || sum(long$value, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
  zb_out(zb_no_data(tr("github.commits.none")))
} else {
  plot <- ggplot(long, aes(x = date, y = value)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, colour = zb_palette[[8L]]) +
    facet_wrap(~repo, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    zb_scale_x_day() +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
    labs(x = tr("common.date"), y = tr("github.commits.axis_y")) +
    zb_theme() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  zb_out(zb_fig(
    plot,
    alt = tr_f("github.commits.alt", date = zb_date(activity_date)),
    caption = zb_chart_dateline(activity_date),
    height = zb_facet_height(length(unique(long$repo)), per = 1.1, base = 1.4)
  ))
}
```
